Geographies Served Programs Investigation Blood investigation for the underprivileged with kidney ailments Providing Quality Dialysis For Underprivileged Ckd Patients District Madurai District Madurai Providing Free and Subsidized dialysis to underprivileged CKD patients through our 14 dialysis centers in and around Chennai (11) and one each in Vellore, Tirupur and Madurai Fistula Surgery A fistula is a minor surgery where a vein and an artery are joined at the wrist to give proper access for dialysis. Financial Help We have also given financial support of Rs. 4 Crores to 4814 patients for transplantation, medication, investigation and fistula surgery costs. Awareness And Screening District Madurai District Madurai Almost 2.5 lakh people die of kidney failure in India every year. It is the third largest killer after malignancy and heart disease. Along with helping our patients, spreading the word about kidney disease is equally important to TANKER.We have also screened 38,000 individuals for early detection of kidney disease through our 468 screening camps.
